learnedRules.name: Autonomous Stock PCR Velocity Engine (Rule 2D)
learnedRules.condition: Stock PCR Drift >= +3.0% (Bullish CE) OR <= -3.0% (Bearish PE)
learnedRules.description: Enables active trade entry on individual F&O stocks showing institutional Put/Call writing conviction.

learnedRules.name: The Post-Crash Morning Reversal Drive (Oct-9 Pattern)
learnedRules.condition: Prior Crash Day + Period A (09:15-09:35) Holds LOD + First-Hour PCR Drift >= +0.03 + Spot above VWAP/R3
learnedRules.description: Captures institutional V-shape short squeezes from morning open. Low of Day locked in Period A. Buys ATM Call targeting Camarilla R4 and Call Wall.

learnedRules.name: Strict Index Upward Confluence Filter for CE
learnedRules.condition: NIFTY Spot > NIFTY Day Open AND PCR Drift >= 0.00
learnedRules.description: Blocks stock CE breakouts if NIFTY is below morning Open or printing negative PCR velocity.

learnedRules.name: Bullish PCR Put Writing Veto for PE Buys
